pattern: SELECT .+ FROM country JOIN countrylanguage ON country\.Code = countrylanguage\.CountryCode WHERE countrylanguage\.(Language|IsOfficial) = '(English|Dutch)'
correction: Separate the conditions for English and Dutch speakers into two separate SELECT statements joined by a UNION, and filter for official languages using 'isofficial = "t"'.

metadata.description: The query combines both conditions in one SELECT statement instead of separating them into two distinct groups.
